name: Neimeth
source: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), six month column, thousands scaled to naira. EPS as printed in kobo converted to naira and confirmed against 4,273,104,000 ordinary shares. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 2026-10-06: 1 blank cell(s) filled from https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ngx/NEIMETH/financials/income-statement/ . Every value this file already stored agreed with that page within 0.5%, so the fill is additive. Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit were re-checked per period; Net Profit was withheld where the source's own figures do not tie.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.source: stockanalysis.com NGX income statement, calibrated to this file's own stored values

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.derivedFormula: Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: EPS
rows.formula: Net Profit / weighted average shares implied by the company's own reported EPS

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note).
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
